purpose: Aggregate social proof: metrics + a grid of short customer testimonial quotes (homepage variant, a static grid, NOT the marquee ticker used on tryvalley/linkedin-automation).

desktop.layout: metrics repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) gap 40; quotes repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) gap 16

customer-photo.guidance: COMPLIANCE: real named customers. Never generate a fabricated likeness of a real person; use a licensed real photo or a generic placeholder avatar.

customer-logo.guidance: Real third-party trademarks; never AI-generate or alter.
